info.name: Paperless Unified Search
info.summary: Search Paperless-ngx OCR content and open matching files in Nextcloud
info.description:
Paperless Unified Search adds Paperless-ngx's native OCR and full-text search to Nextcloud's global search.
Only documents that have a matching, readable Nextcloud file are shown. Matching uses the stable `[P123]` Paperless document marker in synchronized filenames. Selecting a result opens the synchronized file directly in Nextcloud's viewer.
The Paperless API token is stored server-side using Nextcloud's credentials manager and is never sent back to the browser.
info.author: Dennis Otto
